name: Nethanel
overview: Nethanel is a male member of the tribe of Judah, identified as the fourth-born son of Jesse. His role is primarily genealogical, marking his place within the lineage of Judah as recorded in Scripture. There are no additional notes expanding on his life or actions.
namesAndTitles: The name Nethanel means 'G-d [El] has given,' reflecting a theologically significant meaning consistent with Hebrew naming traditions. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 2:14 and was not specifically given by God but carries a divine connotation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Nethanel as a son of Jesse, situating him within a notable family line. Beyond this paternal relationship, no other family connections are recorded in the provided data.
scriptureSignificance: Nethanel's significance lies in his place within the genealogical record of Judah, emphasizing the providential hand of God in the lineage leading to key biblical figures. His designation as the fourth son of Jesse connects him to the family from which King David arose, underscoring the importance of God's provision in the heritage of Israel. While not prominent in narrative events, his mention preserves the continuity of God's covenantal promises through the tribe of Judah.
